_comment: Curated common MCP servers for the console quick-add picker (Settings ▸ MCP ▸ Browse common servers). Each entry's `template` is a partial mcp.servers config with ${input} placeholders the operator fills in before adding. Every command, package and docs link re-verified against upstream 2026-07-27 (npm/PyPI resolution + HTTP status on each docs URL). The reference servers live in modelcontextprotocol/servers (npx for Node, uvx for Python); GitHub/Brave have moved to their own official homes. Keep this in sync with sites/marketing if a public directory is added later. DELIBERATELY NOT LISTED: @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem — protoAgent ships its own fenced filesystem tools (ADR 0007, `filesystem.projects`), which cover the same ground with a directory allowlist, and the third-party server's `search_files` walks its root with no default exclusions (it does not skip node_modules or .git) and no depth or result cap — one call over a 2.75M-entry tree measured 222.7s and wedged a real agent turn. Please don't re-add it as a recommendation.
